# Rejig Labs

> We don't just talk AI. We deliver it. Rejig Labs is an AI automation agency in Thailand, based in Phuket. We find where AI saves your business real time and real money, then build it, implement it, and train your team to run it.

Rejig Labs is an AI automation agency based in Thailand (Phuket / Bangkok, working remotely worldwide). Unlike strategy-only consultants, we audit your workflows, build the custom AI systems ourselves, deploy them into your existing tools, and train your team to run them. Available in English, Thai, and Russian.

## Services

- [Identify](https://rejiglabs.com/#process): We map your acquisition, delivery, and support workflows to find where time is bleeding out and where AI makes the biggest impact. Output: a full AI roadmap in 2–4 weeks.
- [Develop](https://rejiglabs.com/#process): We build custom AI workflows around your existing tools. No rip-and-replace. Value from the first week.
- [Adopt](https://rejiglabs.com/#process): We embed with your team, run training, and refine until the systems feel like second nature.
- [Web3 / Blockchain growth](https://rejiglabs.com/blockchain): Founder-led, execution-obsessed growth marketing for Web3, DeFi, NFT, and AI projects.

## Case Studies

- [All case studies](https://rejiglabs.com/case-studies/): The hub page. One featured study plus every published study, filterable by business type.
- [BoBe, AI trading platform](https://rejiglabs.com/case-studies/bobe): Replaced a $2–3K/month, 1–2-day content team with an autonomous system producing 14 pieces in seconds for under $30/month.
- [Ducky Cutz, barbershop in Phuket](https://rejiglabs.com/case-studies/duckycutz): An AI front desk that answers every call, text, and LINE message in Thai, English, or Russian and books straight into the calendar, day or night, with no staff time needed.
- [ANRCF, Green Charity Golf Tournament](https://rejiglabs.com/case-studies/anrcf-golf): Ran the entire digital operation solo for Thailand's first Green Charity Golf Tournament: a trilingual registration site, sign-up funnel, print and brand collateral, and sponsor outreach. 35 teams, 21 sponsors, 3 languages.
- [Mobile Engineer, elevator installation and service in Phuket](https://rejiglabs.com/case-studies/me-elevator): A 28-year elevator trade business with no website and no lead system. Built the site from scratch in Thai and English, structured it for search and AI answer engines, set up the CRM, advised on positioning, and reworked the lead flow. The site produced a client worth a six-figure baht deal.

## Job Pages

- [Hotel night desk that never misses a call](https://rejiglabs.com/hotel-night-desk-ai/): Rejig Labs runs the hotel phone from 10pm to 7am, handles late check-in calls, escalates the urgent ones, and leaves the front office one summary in the morning.
